info.title: VATKit - EU VAT Number Check (VIES) & VAT Rates
info.description:
# VATKit: EU VAT Number Validation (VIES) and VAT Rates API

Check EU VAT numbers live against the European Commission's VIES service and get the registered company name and address, validate EU and UK VAT number formats offline, look up EU VAT rates, and see which national databases are up. Clean JSON instead of VIES's quirks.

**Who it's for:** B2B e-commerce and SaaS billing (reverse charge), invoicing and accounting software, marketplaces onboarding EU sellers, KYB and compliance teams.

## Use cases
- Apply the reverse charge only after the buyer's VAT number checks out in VIES.
- Auto-fill company name and address in B2B signup forms.
- Keep a VIES consultation number as audit evidence for zero-rated intra-EU supplies.
- Catch typos instantly in checkout forms with /format.
- Charge the right standard rate per country for OSS sales.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://vatkit-eu-vat-number-check-vies-vat-rates.p.rapidapi.com/check?vat=IE6388047V' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: vatkit-eu-vat-number-check-vies-vat-rates.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`vatkit-eu-vat-number-check-vies-vat-rates.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- VIES answers come live from national databases, which are sometimes down or busy. Those cases return `503` with `error_code` (e.g. `MS_UNAVAILABLE`) and `retryable: true`; check /status or retry later.
- Germany and Spain (among others) do not disclose name or address via VIES; `name` and `address` are then null even for a valid number.
- UK (GB) VAT numbers are not in VIES since Brexit; /format validates them offline. Northern Ireland goods traders use the XI prefix, which VIES checks.
- VAT rates are a maintained table of the European Commission's published rates (see `as_of`); regional rates (Canary Islands, Azores, Madeira and so on) are not included.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `422` missing or invalid parameter, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- VAT number checks: European Commission VIES (VAT Information Exchange System) REST service, https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/. Answers come live from each member state's database.
- VAT rates: European Commission, Your Europe 'VAT rules and rates' table (https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/taxation/vat/vat-rules-rates/index_en.htm), maintained as a static table; `as_of` gives the date it reflects.
- Format and check-digit rules: python-stdnum (LGPL-2.1).

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.summary: Check an EU VAT number live in VIES
get.description: Checks a VAT number against the European Commission's VIES service in real time and returns whether it is registered for intra-EU trade, with the trader's name and address when the member state discloses them. Pass `requester_vat` (your own EU VAT number) to also get a VIES consultation number, which is proof of the check for tax audits. Also returns an offline `format_valid` result. UK (GB) numbers are not in VIES; Northern Ireland goods traders use the XI prefix.

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: VAT number with its 2-letter country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V. Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored. Greece uses EL (GR is accepted).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional country prefix, if `vat` is passed without one (e.g. country=IE&vat=6388047V). A matching prefix inside `vat` is tolerated.

parameters.name: requester_vat
parameters.description: Optional: your own EU VAT number with prefix. When given, VIES returns a `consultation_number` you can keep as evidence of the check.

200.description: VIES result. `valid` false means not registered for intra-EU trade.

example.address: 3RD FLOOR, GORDON HOUSE, BARROW STREET, DUBLIN 4
address_lines: 3RD FLOOR, GORDON HOUSE, BARROW STREET, DUBLIN 4
example.name: GOOGLE IRELAND LIMITED
example.note: Some member states (e.g. DE, ES) never return name or address through VIES; null then means 'not disclosed', not 'unknown company'.
example.source: European Commission VIES (VAT Information Exchange System), https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/

422.description: Missing or malformed number, or a country that is not in VIES (e.g. GB, US).

example.error: US is not an EU VIES country code. Supported: AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EL, ES, FI, FR, HR, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK, XI

503.description: VIES or the member state's database is temporarily unavailable (e.g. MS_UNAVAILABLE, MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ, TIMEOUT). `error_code` gives the VIES reason; retry later.

example.error: The member state's VAT database is temporarily unavailable (MS_UNAVAILABLE). Retry in a few seconds or minutes.

get.summary: Validate a VAT number's format offline
get.description: Checks length, structure and check digits for EU (27 member states + XI) and UK (GB) VAT numbers without contacting VIES. Instant, never rate-limited by tax authorities; use it to catch typos in forms before calling /check.

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: VAT number with prefix, e.g. FR40303265045 or GB980780684.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional country prefix, if `vat` is passed without one (e.g. country=IE&vat=6388047V). A matching prefix inside `vat` is tolerated.

example.note: Offline check of length, structure and check digits only. Use /check to confirm the number is actually registered.

422.description: Missing number or unsupported country prefix.

example.error: US is not a supported country prefix. Supported: AT, BE, ...

get.summary: Get EU VAT rates by country
get.description: Returns standard, reduced, super-reduced and parking VAT rates for one EU member state, or all 27 when `country` is omitted. From a maintained table of the European Commission's published rates; `as_of` gives the date it reflects.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional EU country code, e.g. DE, FR, EL (GR accepted). Omit for all 27.

200.description: Rates for one country (or all, as `rates`).

example.source: European Commission, Your Europe: VAT rates applied in EU member countries (https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/taxation/vat/vat-rules-rates/index_en.htm). Regional rates (e.g. Canary Islands, Azores, Madeira) are not included; see the EC Taxes in Europe database for detail.

422.description: Not an EU member state code.

example.error: country must be an EU member state code, e.g. DE, FR, EL (or GR)

get.description: Shows whether VIES and each member state's VAT database are currently available, so you can decide to retry or fall back to /format.

example.source: European Commission VIES (VAT Information Exchange System), https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/

503.description: VIES or the member state's database is temporarily unavailable (e.g. MS_UNAVAILABLE, MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ, TIMEOUT). `error_code` gives the VIES reason; retry later.

example.error: VIES status could not be retrieved, retry shortly

post.summary: MCP server (VATKit tools for AI agents)

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

country_code.description: VIES country code (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland).

valid.description: Registered and active for intra-EU transactions, per VIES.

name.description: Registered trader name (null if not valid or not disclosed by the member state).

address_lines.description: Address split into lines, as supplied by the member state.

consultation_number.description: VIES consultation number (only when `requester_vat` was given).

format_error.description: Why the format failed, if it did.

format_valid.description: Structure and check digits are valid.

error.description: invalid length, invalid checksum, invalid format or invalid component.

checks_checksum.description: Check digits are verified where the country defines them.

VatRatesResponse.description: One country's rates, or all countries' rates in `rates` (plus `count`) when no country is given.

country_code.description: VIES country code (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland).

zero_rate.description: Country applies a zero rate to some supplies.

country_code.description: VIES country code (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland).

zero_rate.description: Country applies a zero rate to some supplies.

country_code.description: VIES country code (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland).

availability.description: Raw VIES status, e.g. Available, Unavailable, Monitoring Disabled.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider

RapidAPIKey.name: X-RapidAPI-Key
RapidAPIKey.description: Your RapidAPI key. Also send header X-RapidAPI-Host: vatkit-eu-vat-number-check-vies-vat-rates.p.rapidapi.com
